briefing: NASDAQ and S&P 500 both edged up +0.5% today, a neutral, low-conviction session with no strong breakout signal. With cash above the $500 threshold and 3 open slots, we deployed modestly into two technically-confirmed momentum names (HRI, TSEM) at medium conviction rather than maxing out all slots, while holding the rest of the portfolio unchanged.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Technical confirmation means only acting on a signal (like a MACD crossover) when several independent indicators agree — RSI in a healthy range, price above its moving average, and rising momentum all pointing the same direction. Relying on one signal alone is more likely to be noise; multiple aligned signals reduce the chance of a false start.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 技術確認是指只有在多個獨立指標同時指向同一方向時才採取行動,例如MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於健康區間、股價高於均線,並且動能持續上升。單一指標容易是市場雜訊,多重訊號同步確認則能降低假訊號的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today with NASDAQ and S&P 500 each up about 0.5%, a quiet, directionless session rather than a decisive risk-on or risk-off move. No standout catalyst emerged; trading looked like routine consolidation after recent gains. With no fresh news items provided today, this move reflects broad market drift rather than a specific headline-driven event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚,納斯達克指數及標普500指數均升約0.5%,屬於方向不明的平淡交易日,未見明顯的風險偏好轉向。市場暫無特別催化劑,走勢較似近期升勢後的整固。由於今日未有提供具體新聞頭條,這波動更多反映大市自然波幅,而非個別消息刺激。
